license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person, directly or indirectly, to engage in or conduct, to advertise or claim to be engaging in or conducting the business, or acting in the capacity of a real estate broker, affiliate broker, time-share salesperson or acquisition agent, as defined in § 62-13-102, within this state, without first obtaining a license as broker, affiliate broker, time-share salesperson or acquisition agent, as provided in this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: There is created the Tennessee real estate commission, referred to in this part as the "commission," which consists of nine (9) members appointed by the governor

moral_character_required.quote: Licenses shall be granted only to persons who bear a good reputation for honesty, trustworthiness, integrity and competence to transact the business of broker, affiliate broker or time-share salesperson in a manner to safeguard the interest of the public

exams.name: Written Examination for Broker's License
exams.notes: Examination for broker's license is of more exacting nature and scope than the affiliate broker examination. Applicant must apply for license within 6 months of passing exam or must retake.
exams.quote: each applicant shall pass a written examination prepared by or under the supervision of the commission

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued under this chapter shall expire two (2) years from the date the license was issued or renewed.

required.quote: Beginning with the license period immediately following the license period in which the licensee completes the one hundred twenty (120) hours of education specified in this subsection (h), the licensee of a broker's license originally issued after January 1, 2005, every two (2) years shall furnish certification of satisfactory completion of sixteen (16) classroom hours in real estate courses at any school, college or university approved by the commission as a requisite for the reissuance of the license.

hours_per_period.quote: every two (2) years shall furnish certification of satisfactory completion of sixteen (16) classroom hours in real estate courses at any school, college or university approved by the commission as a requisite for the reissuance of the license

period_years.quote: every two (2) years shall furnish certification of satisfactory completion of sixteen (16) classroom hours

available.quote: Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, the Tennessee real estate commission has the authority to enter into reciprocity agreements with another state, if in the judgment of the commission that state has meaningful requirements for licensure.

requirements.value: Nonresident applicant must be licensed in another state, qualify by written examination in their state, meet or exceed TN qualifications, certify reading of TN chapter and rules, and applicant's state must permit reciprocal licensure for TN licensees.
requirements.quote: The commission may issue the appropriate license to the nonresident applicant if: (A) The applicant has qualified for the license held in the applicant's state of residence by written examination; (B) The applicant meets or exceeds each of the qualifications for licensure in this state; (C) The applicant certifies that the applicant has read this chapter and the rules and regulations promulgated under this chapter; and (D) The applicant's state of residence permits the issuance of licenses without written examination to brokers, affiliate brokers and time share salespersons resident in and licensed by this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any substantial and willful misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any substantial and willful misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making promises intended to influence a person to enter a contract when the licensee could not or did not intend to keep the promise
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any promise of a character likely to influence, persuade or induce any person to enter into any contract or agreement when the licensee could not or did not intend to keep the promise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making false promises
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making of false promises through affiliate brokers, other persons, any medium of advertising or otherwise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misleading or untruthful advertising, including unauthorized use of 'realtor' or other trade names
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misleading or untruthful advertising, including use of the term "realtor" by a person not authorized to do so, or using any other trade name, insignia or membership in any real estate association or organization of which the licensee is not a member

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within a reasonable time to account for or remit moneys belonging to others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within a reasonable time, to account for or to remit any moneys coming into the licensee's possession that belong to others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to preserve for three years records relating to any real estate transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to preserve for three (3) years following its consummation records relating to any real estate transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without written knowledge and consent of all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one (1) party in a transaction without the knowledge and consent in writing of all parties for whom the licensee acts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish a copy of any listing, sale, lease or other contract to all signatories at time of execution
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish a copy of any listing, sale, lease or other contract relevant to a real estate transaction to all signatories of the contract at the time of execution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or promoting a real estate listing agreement, sales contract or offer to purchase that fails to specify a definite termination date
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or promoting the use of any real estate listing agreement form, real estate sales contract form or offer to purchase real estate form that fails to specify a definite termination date

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing a party to break a contract for the purpose of substituting a new contract for personal gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inducing any party to a contract, sale or lease to break the contract for the purpose of substitution in lieu of the contract a new contract, where the substitution is malicious or is motivated by the personal gain of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affiliate broker accepting commission from anyone other than the licensed broker with whom affiliated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting a commission or any valuable consideration by an affiliate broker for the performance of any acts specified in this chapter, from any person, except the licensed real estate broker with whom the licensee is affiliated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of forgery, embezzlement, fraud, bribery, larceny, extortion, conspiracy to defraud or similar offenses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted in a court of competent jurisdiction of this or any other state or federal court of forgery, embezzlement, obtaining money under false pretenses, bribery, larceny, extortion, conspiracy to defraud or any crime or any similar offense or offenses

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any law prohibiting discrimination in the sale or rental of real estate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any federal, state or municipal law prohibiting discrimination in the sale or rental of real estate because of race, color, religion, sex or national origin

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the chapter, duly promulgated rule, or lawful commission order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter, any rule duly promulgated and adopted under this chapter or the terms of any lawful order entered by the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to exercise adequate supervision over the activities of licensed affiliate brokers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a licensee, failing to exercise adequate supervision over the activities of any licensed affiliate brokers within the scope of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to timely complete administrative measures required by the commission upon transfer or termination of an affiliate broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a licensee, failing within a reasonable time to complete administrative measures that may be required by the commission upon the transfer or termination of any affiliate broker employed by the broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or accepting any undisclosed commission, rebate, compensation or profit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying or accepting, giving or charging any undisclosed commission, rebate, compensation or profit or expenditures for a principal or in violation of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose to owner the licensee's intention to purchase or acquire interest in listed property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose to an owner the licensee's intention or true position if the licensee, directly or indirectly through a third party, purchases for itself or acquires or intends to acquire any interest in or any option to purchase property that has been listed with the licensee's office to sell or lease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the unauthorized practice of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the unauthorized practice of law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct constituting improper, fraudulent or dishonest dealing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct, whether of the same or a different character from that specified in this subsection (b), that constitutes improper, fraudulent or dishonest dealing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the Tennessee Time-Share Act of 1981
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of the Tennessee Time-Share Act of 1981, compiled in title 66, chapter 32, part 1 or any rule duly promulgated under the Tennessee Time-Share Act of 1981

insurance_required.quote: Each licensee who is licensed under this chapter shall, as a condition to licensing, carry errors and omissions insurance to cover all activities contemplated under this chapter.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each office shall have a real estate firm license, a principal broker and a fixed location with adequate facilities for affiliated licensees, located to conform with zoning laws and ordinances.

definition_quote.value: "Broker" means any person who, for a fee, commission, finders fee or any other valuable consideration or with the intent or expectation of receiving a fee, commission, finders fee or any other valuable consideration from another, solicits, negotiates or attempts to solicit or negotiate the listing, sale, purchase, exchange, lease or option to buy, sell, rent or exchange for any real estate or of the improvements on the real estate or any time-share interval as defined in the Tennessee Time-Share Act, compiled in title 66, chapter 32, part 1, collects rents or attempts to collect rents, auctions or offers to auction or who advertises or holds out as engaged in any of the foregoing
definition_quote.quote: "Broker" means any person who, for a fee, commission, finders fee or any other valuable consideration or with the intent or expectation of receiving a fee, commission, finders fee or any other valuable consideration from another, solicits, negotiates or attempts to solicit or negotiate the listing, sale, purchase, exchange, lease or option to buy, sell, rent or exchange for any real estate or of the improvements on the real estate or any time-share interval

required_instruction_topics.quote: including thirty (30) classroom hours covering office or brokerage management

agency_relationship_types.quote: "Designated agent" refers to a licensee who has been chosen by the licensee's managing broker to serve as the agent of an actual or prospective party to a transaction, to the exclusion of other licensees employed by or affiliated with the broker

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: Acting for more than one (1) party in a transaction without the knowledge and consent in writing of all parties for whom the licensee acts

designated_agency_permitted.quote: A licensee entering into a written agreement to represent any party in the buying, selling, exchanging, renting or leasing of real estate may be appointed as the designated and individual agent of this party by the licensee's managing broker, to the exclusion of all other licensees employed by or affiliated with the managing broker.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: "Facilitator" means any licensee: (A) Who assists one (1) or more parties to a transaction who has not entered into a specific written agency agreement representing one (1) or more of the parties

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: If a licensee personally assists a prospective buyer or seller in the purchase or sale of a property and the buyer or seller is not represented by this or any other licensee, the licensee shall verbally disclose to the buyer or seller the licensee's facilitator, agent, subagent or designated agent status in the transaction before any real estate services are provided.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: An agency or subagency relationship shall not be assumed, implied or created without a written bilateral agreement that establishes the terms and conditions of the agency or subagency relationship.

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Using or promoting the use of any real estate listing agreement form, real estate sales contract form or offer to purchase real estate form that fails to specify a definite termination date

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: Failing to preserve for three (3) years following its consummation records relating to any real estate transaction

escrow_account_required.quote: Every broker shall, in accordance with rules promulgated by the commission under § 62-13-203, keep an escrow or trustee account of funds deposited with the broker relating to a real estate transaction.

fixed_office_required.quote: Each office shall have a real estate firm license, a principal broker and a fixed location with adequate facilities for affiliated licensees, located to conform with zoning laws and ordinances.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: Each branch office shall be under the direction and supervision of a broker licensed at that address.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: A sworn statement by the broker with whom the applicant desires to be affiliated certifying that, in the broker's opinion, the applicant is honest and trustworthy and that the broker will actively supervise and train the applicant during the period the license remains in effect.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: A broker, affiliate broker, or other person licensed by the real estate commission may receive compensation directly to a business entity that: (1) Is solely owned by that broker, affiliate broker, or other person; and (2) Has been formed for the purpose of receiving compensation earned by that broker, affiliate broker, or other person for acts regulated by this chapter.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: There is established within the general fund a real estate education and recovery account, referred to as the "account" in this section.

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: The liability of the account shall not exceed fifteen thousand dollars ($15,000) per transaction, regardless of the number of persons aggrieved or parcels of real estate involved in the transaction

recovery_fund_max_per_licensee.quote: The liability of the account for the acts of a broker, affiliate broker or time-share salesperson, when acting as a broker, affiliate broker or time-share salesperson, shall be terminated upon the issuance of court orders authorizing payments from the account for judgments, or any unsatisfied portion of judgments, in an aggregate amount of thirty thousand dollars ($30,000) on behalf of the broker, affiliate broker or time-share salesperson

license_exemptions.quote: This chapter does not apply to: (A) An owner of real estate with respect to property owned or leased by such person; (B) An attorney-in-fact under a duly executed and recorded power of attorney from the owner or lessor; (C) The services rendered by an attorney at law in the performance of duties as an attorney at law
